# Final verification of all requirements
import semver
import subprocess
import sys

print("=== R1: CLI stability ===")
# No arguments should raise SystemExit
try:
    semver.main([])
except SystemExit as e:
    print(f"No args: SystemExit({e.code}) ✅")

# bump without args should show help and exit gracefully
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'semver', 'bump'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if r.returncode == 0 and 'usage' in r.stdout.lower():
    print(f"bump no args: help shown, exit 0 ✅")
else:
    print(f"bump no args: FAILED (rc={r.returncode}, stdout[:200]={r.stdout[:200]})")

print("\n=== R2: Regex alignment with semver.org ===")
# Test strict prerelease rules
test_cases = [
    ("1.0.0-alpha", True),       # valid: alpha is non-numeric
    ("1.0.0-0", True),           # valid: single zero
    ("1.0.0-01", False),         # invalid: leading zero in numeric
    ("1.0.0-alpha.01", False),   # invalid: leading zero in alphanumeric identifier
    ("1.0.0-01alpha", False),    # invalid: leading zero at start of alphanumeric
    ("1.0.0-alpha.1", True),     # valid
    ("1.0.0-1", True),           # valid: numeric prerelease
]
all_pass = True
for v, expected in test_cases:
    result = semver.VersionInfo.isvalid(v)
    status = "✅" if result == expected else "❌"
    if result != expected:
        all_pass = False
    print(f"  {v}: isvalid={result} (expected {expected}) {status}")
print(f"All regex tests pass: {all_pass}")

print("\n=== R3: Validation API ===")
print(f"isvalid exists: {hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid')} ✅")
print(f"1.2.3 is valid: {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3')}")
print(f"invalid is not valid: {not semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('invalid')}")

# Check subcommand
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'semver', 'check', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"check 1.2.3: rc={r.returncode}, out={r.stdout.strip()}")

r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'semver', 'check', 'invalid'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"check invalid: rc={r.returncode}, out={r.stdout.strip()[:100]}")

print("\n=== R4: Public API ===")
print(f"cmd_bump: {hasattr(semver, 'cmd_bump')}")
print(f"cmd_check: {hasattr(semver, 'cmd_check')}")
print(f"cmd_compare: {hasattr(semver, 'cmd_compare')}")
print(f"createparser: {hasattr(semver, 'createparser')}")
print(f"finalize_version: {hasattr(semver, 'finalize_version')}")
print(f"process: {hasattr(semver, 'process')}")

# Verify functions work
print(f"\ncmd_bump('1.0.0') = {semver.cmd_bump('1.0.0')}")
print(f"cmd_check('1.2.3') = {semver.cmd_check('1.2.3')}")
print(f"cmd_compare('1.0.0', '2.0.0') = {semver.cmd_compare('1.0.0', '2.0.0')}")
